welcome:
👋 *Welcome to VPN Subscription Bot\!*

Choose an option below:
help_topup:
💳 *Top Up Balance*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

You can top up your balance via cryptocurrency\.

✅ *Partial payments accepted:*
Send any amount \- 
your balance will increase accordingly\.

📌 *For example:*
• Send `$1` \- balance increases by `$1`
• Send `$5` \- balance increases by `$5`
• When balance reaches `${price}`, you can buy a subscription
help_howtobuy:
🛒 *How to Buy*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1️⃣ Press "💳 Top up balance"
2️⃣ Send crypto to the given address
3️⃣ Press "✅ Check payment"
4️⃣ Wait for confirmation
5️⃣ When balance reaches `${price}`, 
   press "🛒 Buy subscription"
6️⃣ Get your VPN URL and add it to your app\!
help_commands:
📋 *Commands*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

/start \- Start the bot
/help \- Show this help message
/support \- Contact support
help_support:
📞 *Support*

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you have questions or issues,
press "📞 Support" and write to us\.
We will reply as soon as possible\!
